top_choice_rationale: Optical lattice clocks (Katori and Ye) are a distinct invention beyond the 2005 comb and 2012 single-ion prizes: magic-wavelength trapping with Lamb-Dicke confinement lets many atoms be interrogated free of light, Doppler and recoil shifts. The technique has been calibrated, intercompared and reproduced at the 10^-18 level by independent laboratories over fibre, and has opened gravitational-redshift, geodesy and fundamental-constant tests. The two-name allocation is compact and traceable, and the citation is anchored on invention and realisation rather than a record number. Z2 topological insulators come second despite the BHZ attribution gap, IceCube third as its attribution and base of support are narrowest, and no award last because the slate contains mature, independently confirmed achievements.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; astroparticle work (PAMELA, Fermi-LAT, XL-Calibur) is adjacent to IceCube neutrino astronomy (P003) but involves no direct collaboration
